content:
The first release candidate v4.6.0-rc1 for the v4.6.0 release of Lean is available now.

This release brings:

  • custom simplification procedures (aka simprocs) for simp
  • new syntax for termination_by and decreasing_by termination hints (in particular, you can address multiple decreasing goals separately, instead of having to write a single tactic that closes all of them)
  • breaking changes to projects using InfoTree (migration guide at lean#3159)
  • language server support for looking up call hierarchies
  • changes to structure elaboration (lean4#2478)

and many bug fixes to Lean and Lake.

Std, Aesop, and Mathlib, have moved their development branches to v4.6.0-rc1, and lean4checker and the repl are available, too, so please go try out the new goodies!

This is a release candidate, so please expect some rough edges. Please report any issues you find! If anyone finds anything that is a regression relative to v4.5.0, we will likely make a new release candidate. Otherwise, we hope for this to become v4.6.0 at the end of February.
